lora.note: LoraLoaderModelOnly on the UNETLoader's MODEL, as the template's optional style LoRA (node 15); ComfyUI maps Krea2 LoRA keys (comfy/lora.py). One base for both builds: Krea 'TRAIN on Raw and RUN on Turbo' — 'LoRAs trained on RAW apply seamlessly to Turbo'. Civitai base 'Krea 2'. Krea's own style LoRAs (Comfy Cloud has all nine) need their trigger in the prompt, recommended strength 1.0: krea2_darkbrush 'monochrome ink wash style', krea2_dotmatrix 'monochrome stippling style', krea2_kidsdrawing 'naive expressive sketch style', krea2_neondrip 'textured abstract style', krea2_rainywindow 'rainy window style', krea2_retroanime 'purple retro anime style', krea2_softwatercolor 'art deco watercolor style', krea2_sunsetblur 'ethereal motion blur style', krea2_vintagetarot 'vintage tarot style'.

selection.vram_note: NOT FOUND (13.14 GB model + 5.24 GB encoder)
selection.why: the official template: Krea 2 Turbo fp8, 8 steps, cfg 1, euler/simple, 1024x1024 (1K-2K supported); Krea: 'TRAIN on Raw and RUN on Turbo'; docs: fp8 'recommended for most users'. Aesthetic, stylistically diverse images; recreates Civitai 'Krea 2' images
the same Turbo graph on the int8 ConvRot build: 'better quality than FP8 while generally running faster across most GPUs' (template index)

selection.tradeoff: the undistilled base: real CFG and negative, 52 steps (~6.5x Turbo's 8, each with a negative pass), up to ~1K. Krea recommends it for training, not inference — pick it to recreate an image a record says was made on RAW (~50 steps, cfg > 1); Krea's resolution-shifted RAW schedule via ModelSamplingFlux (max_shift 0.91, base_shift 0.5)

rules.message: EmptyLatentImage takes width/height in multiples of 8 (node step 8; 8x VAE)
Krea 2 patchifies the 8x latent in 2x2 blocks: Krea's sampler pads width/height up to a multiple of 16 ('padded up to a multiple of 16 if needed') — use multiples of 16 for the exact size
Krea 2's Qwen3-VL-4B encoder loads through CLIPLoader with type 'krea2' (every Krea 2 template; ComfyUI's Krea2 clip target)
the Krea 2 text encoder is Qwen3-VL-4B (qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled / qwen3vl_4b_bf16 from Comfy-Org/Krea-2); ComfyUI detects it at prefix qwen3vl_4b.transformer. — not the 8B
Krea 2 decodes with qwen_image_vae.safetensors (16-ch; every Krea 2 template; Krea's QwenAutoencoder)
Krea 2 Turbo runs with CFG disabled (Krea README '--cfg 0.0' = ComfyUI cfg 1, the template's value): above 1 adds a negative pass the distilled model was not made for
Krea 2 Turbo is 'an 8-step distilled checkpoint' (README '--steps 8'; template 8)

RAW is undistilled: 'Use the full sampler with classifier-free guidance' (README --cfg 3.5). Krea's --cfg g is ComfyUI cfg g + 1 (Krea: cond + g*(cond-uncond)), so 3.5 = 4.5 here; cfg 1 turns guidance off
RAW is 'the base model with full-step sampling (52 steps)' (README '--steps 52'; Krea's script default 28); 8 steps is the Turbo setting
the recipe's template needs a newer ComfyUI than the pinned image

prompting.negative_note: Turbo: no negative at all — the template feeds ConditioningZeroOut of the positive (CFG disabled); phrase exclusions positively. RAW: a real negative, empty by default (Krea's sampler negative_prompts [''])

positive.line: Natural language: 'We recommend users to use natural language prompts'; 'Long detailed prompts yield best results, but the model is capable of generating high quality images with minimal prompt engineering'
Text rendering: 'we recommend putting quotes around the words to be rendered'

Official examples run from one line ('immense rocket launch exhaust as seen from extremely close up') to dense paragraphs naming subject, medium/style, composition, lighting and palette ('A tiny, russet-brown harvest mouse clings to a slender diagonal branch ... In this macro photograph, an extremely shallow depth of field ...')

The template expands the prompt with Qwen3-VL first (prompt_enhance, on by default; system prompt: preserve every subject, honour a stated medium, quote requested text) — the recipes encode the prompt as written, so write the full description yourself
A style LoRA's trigger goes in the prompt (Krea's nine style LoRAs: see lora.note; recommended strength 1.0)

pitfalls.symptom: RAW looks washed out / ignores the prompt, or is burnt
pitfalls.cause: Krea's --cfg is not ComfyUI's cfg: Krea computes cond + g*(cond - uncond), ComfyUI uncond + cfg*(cond - uncond)
pitfalls.fix: ComfyUI cfg = Krea cfg + 1 (README RAW 3.5 -> 4.5; Turbo 0 -> 1)
